title: Vehicle check
subtitle: The daily vehicle check before leaving each morning, and PPE.
resetNote: Ticks are saved on this iPad. Reset them each morning.
source: LPC Tech Onboarding Pack: vehicle (daily vehicle check) and PPE requirements

sections.body: The company vehicle is for work use only. You are responsible for keeping it clean, stocked and in good order during the week.

sections.heading: Daily vehicle check
sections.title: Before leaving each morning
items: Clean inside and out: professional image starts at the kerb
Chemical stock checked: restock if anything is low
PPE in vehicle (gloves, mask, coveralls, goggles)
SDS sheets present for all chemicals carried
Any vehicle damage, incident or mechanical issue: call Mitch immediately. Do not wait.

sections.heading: PPE requirements
rows: Gloves and closed shoes at minimum on every job
Gloves, mask, eye protection as per product SDS
Dust mask, gloves, torch, appropriate footwear
Gloves at all times when handling traps or bait
Coveralls, gloves, mask. Change before entering next property.

sections.body: Never apply chemicals without PPE. If the SDS requires it, you wear it. No exceptions.
